results.title: FG Unveils $2bn Transmission Project to Strengthen Nigeria’s Power Grid
results.snippet:
The Federal Government has approved a $2 billion investment in a new East-West Super Grid project designed to strengthen Nigeria’s electricity transmission network and expand its capacity to 19,000 megawatts (MW). The project will cover major locations across the country, with the government targeting completion within 18 to 24 months.
